title: Replace dark navy blue theme with stunning light aesthetic theme

requirements.summary: Replace all dark navy blue colors with soft warm ivory/pearl cream background (#F8F5F0) throughout the entire application
acceptanceCriteria: All pages display #F8F5F0 as the primary background color
No dark navy blue backgrounds remain anywhere in the application
Background color is consistent across desktop, mobile, and tablet viewports

file_operations.description: Update CSS custom properties to set --background and body background to #F8F5F0. Replace any dark navy blue color values with the soft warm ivory/pearl cream. Update the root-level background definitions to ensure consistent application-wide coverage.
Update the colors.background configuration to use #F8F5F0 as the primary background color. Remove or replace any dark navy blue color tokens with the light aesthetic palette.

requirements.summary: Apply gradient backgrounds to section elements using linear-gradient(135deg, #F8F5F0 0%, #F5F0E6 100%)
acceptanceCriteria: Hero sections, category sections, and feature sections display the specified gradient
Gradient maintains consistent appearance across all screen sizes

file_operations.description: Add utility classes or update existing section background styles to apply linear-gradient(135deg, #F8F5F0 0%, #F5F0E6 100%). Target hero sections, category showcase sections, and feature blocks with the gradient background.
Update section container backgrounds to use the gradient. Apply the gradient to hero container, category navigation area, and featured products section backgrounds.
Update the hero slider background to use the gradient linear-gradient(135deg, #F8F5F0 0%, #F5F0E6 100%) instead of any dark backgrounds.
Apply the gradient background to the product marketing section container.

requirements.summary: Update primary accent color to antique gold (#C9A96E) for buttons, borders, highlights, and interactive elements
acceptanceCriteria: All buttons use #C9A96E as background color
Interactive elements and borders use antique gold for visual emphasis
Hover states deepen the gold color and add subtle lift + glow effects

file_operations.description: Update button styles to use #C9A96E as the background color. Modify hover states to darken the gold (e.g., #B8955D) and add transform: translateY(-2px) lift effect plus box-shadow glow. Update border color utilities to use antique gold for highlights and focus states.
Update colors.primary configuration to #C9A96E. Ensure border, ring, and accent color tokens reflect the antique gold palette. Add hover variant with deeper gold tone if needed.

requirements.summary: Apply secondary accent color of muted blush rose gold (#E8C0C8) to category titles and decorative elements
acceptanceCriteria: Category and special titles display #E8C0C8 color
Secondary decorative elements use the blush rose gold accent appropriately

file_operations.description: Add or update CSS custom property for secondary accent color to #E8C0C8. Apply this color to category title styles and decorative text elements.
Update colors.secondary configuration to #E8C0C8 for use in category titles and decorative UI elements.
Update category title text colors to use #E8C0C8 blush rose gold.
Apply #E8C0C8 color to category titles and decorative elements within the trending categories section.

requirements.summary: Update primary text color to deep charcoal (#1A1A1A) and secondary text to warm taupe gray (#5C4B51)
acceptanceCriteria: All primary text (body, descriptions, labels) displays in #1A1A1A
Secondary text (captions, meta info) displays in #5C4B51
Text contrast meets WCAG accessibility standards on light backgrounds

file_operations.description: Update --foreground and body color to #1A1A1A for primary text. Add or update secondary text color variable to #5C4B51. Apply these colors to all text elements ensuring proper hierarchy (body, paragraphs, labels use #1A1A1A; captions, metadata use #5C4B51).
Update colors.foreground to #1A1A1A and add colors.muted.foreground as #5C4B51 for secondary text. Ensure text color utilities reflect the new palette.

requirements.summary: Style buttons with antique gold background (#C9A96E), dark text, and hover effects with deeper gold, lift animation, and glow
acceptanceCriteria: All CTA buttons display #C9A96E background with dark text
Hover state darkens gold color and adds subtle transform lift
Hover state includes a soft glow effect around button edges

file_operations.description: Update all button classes to use background-color: #C9A96E and color: #1A1A1A (dark text). Add hover:bg-[#B8955D] hover:translate-y-[-2px] and hover:shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(201,169,110,0.4)] for lift and glow effects. Ensure transition properties are smooth.

requirements.summary: Style product cards and content cards with pure white background (#FFFFFF), 1px gold border (#C9A96E), and soft shadow
acceptanceCriteria: Product cards display white background with exactly 1px gold border
Cards include subtle box-shadow for depth
Card styling is consistent across product grid, quick view, and detail pages

file_operations.description: Update card container styling to use background: #FFFFFF, border: 1px solid #C9A96E, and box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08) for soft depth.
Apply white background (#FFFFFF) with 1px gold border (#C9A96E) and soft shadow to the quick view sheet content card.
Update product detail modal card styling to use white background with 1px gold border and soft shadow.
Add or update card utility classes to enforce white background (#FFFFFF), 1px solid #C9A96E border, and subtle box-shadow across all card components.

requirements.summary: Update heading font to Playfair Display ExtraBold with antique gold color (#C9A96E)
acceptanceCriteria: All h1, h2, h3 elements use Playfair Display ExtraBold
Heading text displays in #C9A96E color
Font loads correctly from Google Fonts with proper fallbacks

file_operations.description: Update h1, h2, h3 styles to use font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-weight: 800 (ExtraBold); and color: #C9A96E. Ensure fallback fonts are included.
Verify fontFamily.heading includes 'Playfair Display' with ExtraBold weight. Update heading color utilities to default to #C9A96E.
Verify Google Fonts preconnect link includes Playfair Display with weights including 800 (ExtraBold) to ensure proper font loading.

requirements.summary: Apply Great Vibes Regular font to category titles and special decorative titles with color #E8C0C8
acceptanceCriteria: Category navigation titles use Great Vibes Regular script font
Special decorative titles display in #E8C0C8 blush rose gold
Font provides elegant script aesthetic without sacrificing readability

file_operations.description: Add or update a utility class for category/special titles to use font-family: 'Great Vibes', cursive; font-weight: 400; and color: #E8C0C8. Apply this class to category navigation and decorative title elements.
Apply Great Vibes Regular font and #E8C0C8 color to category title text elements.
Update category titles to use Great Vibes Regular font with #E8C0C8 color.
Verify Google Fonts preconnect link includes Great Vibes to ensure proper font loading.

requirements.summary: Set body text font to Lora Regular with deep charcoal color (#1A1A1A)
acceptanceCriteria: All paragraph text, descriptions, and body content use Lora Regular
Body text displays in #1A1A1A color for optimal readability
Font renders consistently across all browsers

file_operations.description: Update body and paragraph styles to use font-family: 'Lora', serif; font-weight: 400; and color: #1A1A1A. Ensure this applies to all description text, product details, and body content.
Update fontFamily.body or fontFamily.sans to include 'Lora' as the primary body font.
Verify Google Fonts preconnect link includes Lora Regular to ensure proper font loading.

requirements.summary: Apply Montserrat Bold font to all button text and call-to-action elements
acceptanceCriteria: Button text uses Montserrat Bold font family
CTA elements display clear, bold typography
Button text remains legible on antique gold backgrounds

file_operations.description: Update button text styles to use font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; font-weight: 700 (Bold); Ensure text color provides sufficient contrast on #C9A96E backgrounds (use #1A1A1A for legibility).
Verify fontFamily configuration includes 'Montserrat' for button and CTA elements.
Verify Google Fonts preconnect link includes Montserrat with weight 700 (Bold) to ensure proper font loading.

requirements.summary: Remove all media query overrides for colors, fonts, and backgrounds to force identical light theme appearance across desktop, laptop, and mobile viewports
acceptanceCriteria: Color palette remains identical on all screen sizes
Font families and weights are consistent across all viewports
Background colors and gradients do not change based on media queries
Only layout and spacing adjustments are allowed in responsive breakpoints

file_operations.description: Audit and remove all @media queries that override colors, font-family, font-weight, or background colors. Preserve only media queries that adjust layout properties (width, padding, margin, flex-direction, grid-columns). Ensure color and typography remain consistent across all breakpoints.
Review any responsive variants or breakpoint-specific color/font configurations and remove overrides that change the light aesthetic palette. Ensure color tokens are viewport-agnostic.

requirements.summary: Audit and eliminate all instances of dark navy blue colors from the entire codebase, replacing with the light aesthetic palette
acceptanceCriteria: Search codebase confirms zero hex codes matching dark blue patterns (#001f3f, #003366, #000080, etc.)
Visual inspection shows no dark blue elements on any page
Theme switcher (if present) only shows light theme option

file_operations.description: Search and replace all instances of dark navy blue hex codes (e.g., #001f3f, #003366, #000080, #1a202c, #2c3e50, any blue-900/blue-950 references) with appropriate light palette colors (#F8F5F0 for backgrounds, #C9A96E for accents, #1A1A1A for text). Ensure no dark blue values remain.
Remove or replace any dark navy blue color definitions in the colors configuration. Audit theme extensions for blue-900, blue-950, or custom dark blue tokens and eliminate them.
If a theme switcher exists, disable or remove the dark mode option, ensuring only the light theme is available and active.
If the ocean background uses dark navy blue colors, update the canvas rendering to use light aesthetic palette colors (ivory, pearl, soft gradients) instead of dark blues.
Update the animated ambience background to use light palette colors (pearl shimmer, soft gold) instead of any dark navy blue tones.
If pearl shimmer particles use dark backgrounds or navy blue tones, replace with light aesthetic colors (pearl cream, soft ivory, antique gold glows).
Ensure gold wave animations use the antique gold (#C9A96E) color and render against the light background (#F8F5F0) without any dark blue elements.

requirements.summary: Preserve all existing functionality including login/OTP flow, Internet Identity, profile dashboard, cart icon, addresses, orders, and product catalog while applying light theme
acceptanceCriteria: Login and OTP verification continue to work without errors
Internet Identity authentication remains functional
Profile dashboard displays user details, addresses, and orders correctly
Cart icon shows accurate item count and cart panel functions properly
Product catalog loads and displays all products with new theme applied

file_operations.description: Update component styling to use light aesthetic theme colors (backgrounds, text, buttons, inputs) without modifying authentication logic or flow. Ensure OTP inputs, phone validation, and Internet Identity integration remain fully functional.
Apply light theme styling to the dashboard tabs, profile form, address cards, and order history sections. Preserve all data fetching, form submission, and CRUD functionality without modification.
Update header styling to use light aesthetic palette (background, text, button colors, cart badge). Ensure cart icon, authentication dropdown, and navigation links remain fully functional.
Apply light theme colors to cart panel, item cards, quantity controls, and checkout button. Preserve all cart operations (add, remove, update quantity) without modification.
Update product grid, card backgrounds, and pagination controls to use light aesthetic theme. Preserve product fetching, quick view, detail navigation, and admin CTA functionality.
Apply light theme styling to checkout form fields, address inputs, and payment button. Ensure Razorpay integration and order creation logic remain fully functional.
